title: Terraform State Migration
description: Migrate Terraform state from local backend to S3 with DynamoDB locking: plan, apply, verify, rollback on failure

steps.description: Take snapshot of current local state file and upload to secure backup bucket
Run terraform plan with new backend config; verify 0 resources to change (state-only migration)
Run terraform init -migrate-state to move state to S3 backend
Confirm state file exists in S3, DynamoDB lock table is operational, terraform plan shows no drift
Acquire and release DynamoDB lock; confirm concurrent apply is blocked
If any verification step fails, restore local state from backup and revert backend config

checks: S3 bucket contains state file with correct key
DynamoDB table has LockID with state file entry
CloudTrail shows PutObject to S3 state bucket
verification.success_criteria: All checks pass and terraform plan shows 0 drift

rollback_plan.trigger_condition: terraform plan shows unexpected changes OR lock table is inaccessible OR state file checksum mismatch
steps: Run terraform state push from local backup
Run terraform init to reconnect to local backend
Verify terraform plan matches pre-migration state
